selection: Per family, first recipe clean on one low/mid/hard screen and then five disjoint-from-main probe items on two draws. Screen responses are reused as the corresponding validation draw, not repurchased. Never select by accuracy.
main: Exactly 15 frozen original items per family, two Fable draws each. A family without validated no-CoT recipe is unmeasured, not silently omitted or scored zero.
positive_control: One maximum-effort probe per measured family must have a present, nonzero thinking-token counter.
budget: Completed usage retained at 1.2 times standard cost, outstanding requests at full reservation. Reserve next request with 25%+256 extra input tokens and full max output, all at 1.2x standard rates. Require total <=$4 before transmitting. No automatic retries.
comparison: Regrade both models using same upstream answer grader and normalize JSON answers consistently. Nontruncated reasoning is wrong; truncation/blind is missing. Report matched nonmissing pairs and separate missingness/invalidity.
